The '''Wood Club''' is a [[Weapons#Club|club weapon]] that can be obtained by [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|breaking boxes and barrels]], or as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special monster drop]], on floors 1-39 in [[The Mines]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 20 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.
